Fetch PubMed records by DOI

Source: R/pmFetchByDoi.R
pmFetchByDoi.Rd

It downloads the PubMed records of a set of articles identified by their DOI, for instance to complete a collection coming from another database.

Usage

pmFetchByDoi(dois, api_key = NULL, batch_size = 50)

Arguments

dois

is a character vector of DOIs, with or without the https://doi.org/ prefix.

api_key

is a character. A valid API key for the NCBI E-utilities. Default is api_key=NULL. It can also be set via the environment variable PUBMED_API_KEY or ENTREZ_KEY.

batch_size

is numeric. DOIs per search. Default is 50.

Value

a list with the same structure as the output of pmFetchById, ready for pmApi2df, with one more element: not_found, the DOIs with no PubMed record.

See also

pmFetchById, pmApi2df

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
D <- pmFetchByDoi(c("10.1016/j.joi.2017.08.007", "10.1038/nature14539"))
D$not_found
M <- pmApi2df(D)
}
